Messages.Author: Bartłomiej "veyDer" Rudzki
Messages.Body:
1. Does the vampire affected by this card keep the special abilities
when enslaved?
2. What is the name of the slave? If Enid Blount is changed into a
slave Gargoyle, does the Edith Blount's special ability work?
3. What is the sect of the new slave Gargoyle (the old sect or the
default one for the acting vampire's clan)?
4. What is the starting blood of the slave Gargoyle?
5. Does the slave Gargoyle keep the equipment and other cards?
6. What happens if the slave Gargoyle is burned? Does the original
vampire card go back to the owner's ash heap, the controller's ash
heap or is it removed from the game?
7. Is the slave Gargoyle still considered a unique copy of the
original vampire? Eg. if Arika is targeted by this card, can another
Arika be influenced out? If so, what happens if the second Arika is
Raw Recruit-ed as well? Does it contest the first one?
8. Is a non-unique vampire targeted by this card also considered non-
unique?

Thanks,
veyDer

Messages.Body:

Raw Recruit
Action
Gargoyle
+1 stealth action. Requires a slave.
(D) Put this card in play and move a vampire in torpor to this card,
out of play. A vampire you control to whom this Gargoyle is a slave
may remove that vampire from the game as a +1 stealth action to turn
this card into a Gargoyle with the same capacity and Fortitude,
Potence, Visceratika and flight, enslaved to the acting vampire's
clan.

No.

> 3. What is the sect of the new slave Gargoyle (the old sect or the

Newly created Gargoyles are Independent.

> 4. What is the starting blood of the slave Gargoyle?

Zero.

No.

> 6. What happens if the slave Gargoyle is burned?

The world ends.

Original vampire > original owner's ash heap

> 7. Is the slave Gargoyle still considered a unique copy of the

No.

> Eg. if Arika is targeted by this card, can another
> Arika be influenced out?

Yes.

> If so, what happens if the second Arika is

You pound the table and crow like a rooster.

> Does it contest the first one?

No.

> 8. Is a non-unique vampire targeted by this card also considered non-
> unique?

All gargoyles created by Raw Recruit are non-unique.

Carpe noctem.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Mar 2, 3:42 pm, The Lasombra <thelasom...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> On Mar 2, 3:36 pm, Bartłomiej "veyDer" Rudzki wrote:
>
> Raw Recruit
> Action
> Gargoyle
> +1 stealth action. Requires a slave.
> (D) Put this card in play and move a vampire in torpor to this card,
> out of play. A vampire you control to whom this Gargoyle is a slave
> may remove that vampire from the game as a +1 stealth action to turn
> this card into a Gargoyle with the same capacity and Fortitude,
> Potence, Visceratika and flight, enslaved to the acting vampire's
> clan.
>
> > 1. Does the vampire affected by this card keep the special abilities
> > when enslaved?
>
> No.

Correct. Or more properly: "Moot", since the vampire affected is
removed from the game. Xe is never enslaved. "This card" (the action
card) is enslaved (and this action card has no "special abilities" in
that sense).

> > 2. What is the name of the slave?
>
> Sean.  Or Oscar.  Sometimes Ben.  Occasionally Cylon Scott.

Correct enough. The recruit-card-turned-Gargoyle is non-unique.

> > If Enid Blount is changed into a
> > slave Gargoyle, does the Edith Blount's special ability work?
>
> No.
>
> > 3. What is the sect of the new slave Gargoyle (the old sect or the
> > default one for the acting vampire's clan)?
>
> Newly created Gargoyles are Independent.
>
> > 4. What is the starting blood of the slave Gargoyle?
>
> Zero.

Correct.

> > 5. Does the slave Gargoyle keep the equipment and other cards?
>
> No.

Well, the equipment and other cards aren't moved to the recruit,
correct. They are burned when the card they are on is removed from the
game.

> > 6. What happens if the slave Gargoyle is burned?
>
> The world ends.

Probably not.

The recruit action card goes to the ash heap when burned.

> > Does the original vampire card go back to the owner's ash heap, the controller's ash
> > heap or is it removed from the game?
>
> Original vampire > original owner's ash heap

Well, the original vampire was removed from the game back when the
recruit was turned into a Gargoyle. It remains out of the game when
the recruit-turned-Gargoyle is burned.

Indeed, it remains out of the game no matter what happens in the game,
by definition of "remove from game".

> > 7. Is the slave Gargoyle still considered a unique copy of the
> > original vampire?
>
> No.
>
> > Eg. if Arika is targeted by this card, can another
> > Arika be influenced out?
>
> Yes.

Correct.

> > If so, what happens if the second Arika is
> > Raw Recruit-ed as well?
>
> You pound the table and crow like a rooster.

Perhaps.

> > Does it contest the first one?
>
> No.

Correct.

> > 8. Is a non-unique vampire targeted by this card also considered non-
> > unique?
>
> All gargoyles created by Raw Recruit are non-unique.

Correct.

Messages.Author: OldFan
Messages.Body:


Well - I am not the OP of this particular comment, but being the "King
of All things that are WAY too complicated for something that is
ALMOST effective - In Ithaca, NY!", I would posit the following
hypothetical:

1.) Influence out a bunch of Gargoyles, Malachai being a possible star
for having some (pre) already built in. Have some supporting Tremere
or !Tremere, preferably with some obf/OBF, to lend some stealth
support, along with built in DOM

2.) Get an Anarch Convert to turn Malachai into an Anarch. Possibly
turn some other Gargoyles or support minions into anarchs, but not
really necessary

3.) Use the bunch of Gargoyles you have created, and run around
punching opposing vampires into torpor. If you have Carver's meat
packing, Torpid Blood, or some other shenanigan to make rescues more
difficult, better for you.

4.) Proceed to "Raw Recruit" and "Graverobbing" steal all of these
various torporized minions, and make them Anarch with some various or
sundry mechanism. Presumably you have accumulated no small number of
them. Also make some Hatchlings and Create Gargoyles along the way,
for more ammo (see below).

5.) Have Malachai become a Baron with some Fee Stake. Untap with
Freak Drive/As the Crow.

6.) Fire the Death Star Cannon (aka "Revolutionary Council") at
opposing Methuselahs until they are dead. Some pre on Malachai gives
you push (with Bewitching, Iron Glare), PLUS you have presumably run
around and torporized/Raw Recruited any opposing minions who could
possibly foil your nefarious plan (i.e. people with titles or votes or
something that nerfs voting).

7.) Win!

Errrr......yeah, kinda dubious, but it's doable! No - Really!

But as Peter constantly remonstrates me while laughing "Well, it's Hi-
freakin-larious, but it seems like an awful lot of work for something
that's ALMOST effective. Wouldn't you be better off just using KRC/
Reck ag?"

Sure - but what would the fun in that be?! :-)

-AC
